event.question: Who holds conflicting roles in Ledgerly, and which manager must certify each one?

findings.evidence: Ledgerly active account dnair holds roles VENDOR_ADMIN and PAYMENT_APPROVER, violating SOD-01 (Can create a vendor and approve payments to it). HR record: Deepak Nair, E1024, active, Procurement Manager, manager=Suresh Menon (E1005) per PeopleHub.
findings.recommended_action: Remove one of the two roles, decided by the certifier Suresh Menon.

findings.recommended_action: Remove one of the two roles, decided by the certifier Ritu Bhatt.

findings.recommended_action: Remove one of the two roles, decided by the certifier Rakesh Iyer.

findings.evidence: Ledgerly active account rpatel holds roles PAYMENT_APPROVER and AP_CLERK, violating SOD-02. HR record: Rahul Patel, E1012, terminated 2026-11-03, AP Supervisor, manager=Ritu Bhatt (E1003) per PeopleHub; account signed in after termination on 2026-11-06 per Ledgerly.
findings.recommended_action: Remove one of the two roles, decided by the certifier Ritu Bhatt.

event.answer:

- dnair (Procurement Manager, Suresh Menon) holds VENDOR_ADMIN and PAYMENT_APPROVER, breaching SOD-01.
- abose (AP Supervisor, Ritu Bhatt) holds AP_CLERK and PAYMENT_APPROVER, breaching SOD-02.
- rgupta (Sales Executive, Rakesh Iyer) holds AP_CLERK and PAYMENT_APPROVER, breaching SOD-02.
- rpatel (terminated 2026-11-03, Ritu Bhatt) holds PAYMENT_APPROVER and AP_CLERK, breaching SOD-02; signed in after leaving.
